correctness.rationale: For an even wheel C_{2m} with m≥2, hub vacancy forces the rim to be perfectly matched by one of exactly two alternating matchings. Conditional on matching-edge arrival times t_j, both endpoint spokes must arrive after t_j, and each interposed rim edge after min(t_j,t_{j+1}); integrating independent exponential densities yields P_{2m}=2∫exp[-3∑t_j-∑min(t_j,t_{j+1})]dt. The strictly positive, trace-class kernel K(t,s)=exp[-3(t+s)/2-min(t,s)] gives 2tr(K^m). Spectral simplicity and domination follow from positivity improving compactness; the bounded positive eigenfunction solves u´´+u´-λ^{-1}exp(-4t)u=0 with Robin boundary u´(0)=-u(0), which yields 2zI_{3/4}(z)=I_{-1/4}(z), λ=1/(4z²). Independent rational first-event recurrence at spoke/rim ratio one gives P4=1/6, P6=1/21, P8=19/1386, P10=41/10395, agreeing with the frozen proof, and λ≈0.287730645241419. Odd rims cannot perfectly match. Finite checks support only stated finite cases; infinite decay follows from operator proof.
